verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server, plus an Anthropic Messages API, with tool calling (named, auto, required and none tool_choice), reasoning parsers and streaming. These are the core interfaces a coding agent needs to use it as a backend, and a community user confirms the OpenAI-compatible API lets existing ChatGPT applications plug in. Missing for 10: a first-party guide for connecting a specific coding agent, and independent hands-on reports of coding agents running reliably against vLLM.
